# `liber:typec@1`

Generated reference for the `liber:typec` package (`typec.lsidl`). See [the LSIDL language](../../../LSIDL.md).

LiberSystem Type-C - what a USB Type-C connector reports: its partner, its roles, the Power Delivery contract it made, the offers it was made from, its cable and its alternate modes - and the four requests an operator may make.  THREE INTERFACES FOR THREE PARTIES. A READER enumerates and subscribes; an OPERATOR swaps a role or enters and leaves a mode; a PROVIDER - the `ucsi-acpi` or `tcpci` driver - publishes what its connectors report. None of them reaches the others' operations, because what separates them is who holds them.  WHAT IS HERE AND NOWHERE ELSE. The data role and DisplayPort are reported here: no USB driver knows a data role, nothing maps a connector to a root-hub port, and no display controller takes an alternate mode. A partner as a SUPPLY is `liber:power@1`'s `usb-c` source, carrying only what is measured; the contract and the offers are a LIMIT, not a measurement, and are here.

## Interfaces

### interface `typec-provider`

THE PROVIDER CONTRACT a `typec-connector` publication serves - to TypeCService alone.

Request `[op u16][corr u32][args]`, reply `[corr u32][result]`.

| op | method | signature | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `updates` | `updates() -> stream<provider-update>` |  |
| 2 | `request` | `request(request: request) -> result<answer, error>` |  |

### interface `typec`

THE READ AUTHORITY: enumerate, and subscribe.

Request `[op u16][corr u32][args]`, reply `[corr u32][result]`.

| op | method | signature | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `connectors` | `connectors() -> result<list<connector-snapshot>, error>` | Every live connector, sorted. Informational: a subscription is correct without it. |
| 2 | `subscribe` | `subscribe() -> result<stream<typec-change>, error>` | One atomic snapshot at (epoch, revision), then live changes after it. REFUSED with `exhausted` at the service's subscriber limit. |

### interface `typec-control`

THE OPERATOR AUTHORITY: one request outstanding per connector, answered within fifteen seconds - `done`, `refused` with its reason, or `indeterminate`, which is never retried. Granted to no shipping program by default.

Request `[op u16][corr u32][args]`, reply `[corr u32][result]`.

| op | method | signature | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `data-role-swap` | `data-role-swap(connector: connector-id, role: data-role) -> result<answer, error>` |  |
| 2 | `power-role-swap` | `power-role-swap(connector: connector-id, role: power-role) -> result<answer, error>` |  |
| 3 | `enter-mode` | `enter-mode(connector: connector-id, svid: u16, vdo: u32) -> result<answer, error>` |  |
| 4 | `exit-mode` | `exit-mode(connector: connector-id, svid: u16, vdo: u32) -> result<answer, error>` |  |
